title: cddl-codegen config
description: Schema for a cddl-codegen `--config` TOML file. Generated from `struct Settings`, `struct CrateEntry` and `struct Runtime` in src/config.rs by the `editor_schema_matches_the_config_surface` test — edit those and re-bless rather than editing this file.

defaults.description: Settings every crate starts from — the lowest layer of the merge.

profiles.description: Named shared layers, applied by the crates whose `profiles` list names them.

crates.description: One table per generated crate, keyed by the crate's name.

runtime.description: Config-wide runtime settings: which crate exports the shared serialization runtime, and what every crate imports.
